sentences.text: Look at the end of your finger.
There are small lines on it.
They go round and round.
Everybody has them.
And nobody has the same ones.
sentences.translationRu: И ни у кого они не одинаковые.

sentences.text: Even twins have different ones.
They are made before you are born.
At about four months.
The skin grows a little too fast.
sentences.translationRu: Кожа растёт чуть быстрее, чем нужно.

sentences.text: So it folds, like cloth in a bag.
sentences.translationRu: И складывается, как ткань в сумке.

sentences.text: Where it folds depends on many things.
sentences.translationRu: Куда она сложится, зависит от многого.

sentences.text: How you moved. Where your hand was.
sentences.translationRu: Как ты двигался. Где была рука.

sentences.text: What the mother ate that week.
sentences.translationRu: Что мать ела на той неделе.

sentences.text: None of this can repeat.
So the pattern never repeats either.
They also never change.
Cut your finger and it grows back.
The same pattern comes back with it.
sentences.translationRu: И тот же рисунок вернётся вместе с кожей.

sentences.text: But what are they for?
For a long time the answer was grip.
Like the lines on a car tyre.
It sounds right.
Scientists tested it.
They found something surprising.
On dry, flat things, they do not help.
sentences.translationRu: На сухом и гладком они не помогают.

sentences.text: A flat finger holds better.
Lines take away skin that could touch.
sentences.translationRu: Линии убирают кожу, которая могла бы касаться.

sentences.text: So the answer is probably not grip.
sentences.translationRu: Значит, дело, вероятно, не в хватании.

sentences.text: There are two better ideas.
The first one is water.
When your hand is wet, water gets in the way.
The lines let it run out.
Like the lines on a tyre in rain.
sentences.translationRu: Как канавки на шине под дождём.

sentences.text: The second idea is feeling.
Under the skin there are small sensors.
They sit right under the lines.
When you touch something rough,
the lines shake a little.
The sensors feel that shaking.
Without the lines, you feel much less.
sentences.translationRu: Без линий ты чувствуешь намного меньше.

sentences.text: So fingerprints may not be for holding.
sentences.translationRu: Так что отпечатки, возможно, не для удержания.

sentences.text: They may be for knowing what you hold.
sentences.translationRu: А для того, чтобы знать, что ты держишь.

title: A dog can smell what happened an hour ago

sentences.text: A dog stops at a wall and smells it.
sentences.translationRu: Собака останавливается у стены и нюхает.

sentences.text: For a long time. Very carefully.
You wait. You pull the lead.
To you the wall is just a wall.
To the dog it is a page of news.
The numbers are hard to believe.
A person has about six million sensors.
sentences.translationRu: У человека около шести миллионов рецепторов.

sentences.text: A dog has around three hundred million.
And the part of the brain that reads them
sentences.translationRu: А отдел мозга, который их читает,

sentences.text: is much larger, compared to the rest.
sentences.translationRu: гораздо больше по сравнению с остальным.

sentences.text: But the numbers are not the interesting part.
sentences.translationRu: Но самое интересное не в цифрах.

sentences.text: The interesting part is time.
A smell does not stay the same.
It gets weaker, hour by hour.
A dog can tell how weak it is.
So it knows how old the smell is.
sentences.translationRu: И потому знает, сколько запаху лет.

sentences.text: Somebody walked here.
They walked here about two hours ago.
And they were walking that way.
Because the smell is stronger behind them.
sentences.translationRu: Потому что позади него запах сильнее.

sentences.text: A dog following a trail knows the direction
sentences.translationRu: Собака, идущая по следу, знает направление

sentences.text: after only a few steps.
It compares one footprint with the next.
sentences.translationRu: Она сравнивает один след со следующим.

sentences.text: Weaker, weaker, stronger.
So: that way.
Their noses are also built differently.
sentences.translationRu: И нос у них устроен иначе.

sentences.text: We breathe in and out through the same hole.
sentences.translationRu: Мы вдыхаем и выдыхаем через одно отверстие.

sentences.text: So we push the smell away when we breathe out.
A dog breathes out through the sides.
The air goes backwards, not forwards.
sentences.translationRu: Воздух уходит назад, а не вперёд.

sentences.text: So the smell in front is never disturbed.
This is why they sniff so fast.
Five or six times a second.
Each sniff is a new picture.
They can also smell with two nostrils separately.
sentences.translationRu: Они ещё и нюхают каждой ноздрёй отдельно.

sentences.text: Left and right give different information.
sentences.translationRu: Левая и правая дают разные сведения.

sentences.text: Like two ears and one sound.
sentences.translationRu: Как два уха и один звук.

sentences.text: That is how they point at things.
So when a dog stops at a wall,
sentences.translationRu: Так что когда собака встаёт у стены,

sentences.text: it is not being slow.
It is reading who was here,
when, and which way they went.

title: What is happening inside a lock

sentences.text: A lock is one of the oldest machines we have.
sentences.translationRu: Замок — одна из старейших наших машин.

sentences.text: Older than the wheel in some places.
And the basic idea has not changed.
A door is held shut by a bolt.
The bolt cannot move unless something turns.
sentences.translationRu: Засов не сдвинется, пока что-то не повернётся.

sentences.text: Inside the lock there is a small cylinder.
It sits inside a larger piece of metal.
sentences.translationRu: Он сидит внутри более крупной детали.

sentences.text: Normally the cylinder cannot turn.
Something is holding it in place.
That something is a row of small pins.
Each pin is cut into two pieces.
sentences.translationRu: Каждый штифт разрезан на две части.

sentences.text: A short piece and a long piece.
A spring pushes them down.
With no key in the lock,
each pin crosses the line between the two parts.
sentences.translationRu: каждый штифт пересекает границу между двумя деталями.

sentences.text: Like a bolt through two pieces of wood.
Nothing can turn.
Now put in the right key.
Look at the teeth on top of it.
sentences.translationRu: Посмотри на зубцы на его верхней кромке.

sentences.text: Each tooth is a different height.
Each one lifts one pin.
It lifts it exactly the right amount.
So that the cut in the pin
lines up with the edge of the cylinder.
Do that for all five pins at once
sentences.translationRu: Сделай это сразу для всех пяти штифтов —

sentences.text: and there is a clean line all the way through.
sentences.translationRu: и по всей длине образуется чистая линия.

sentences.text: Now the cylinder turns.
The bolt moves. The door opens.
A wrong key lifts the pins wrongly.
sentences.translationRu: Неправильный ключ поднимает штифты не так.

sentences.text: Too high, too low, in the wrong order.
sentences.translationRu: Слишком высоко, слишком низко, не в том порядке.

sentences.text: One pin out of place is enough.
sentences.translationRu: Одного штифта не на месте достаточно.

sentences.text: Which is also the weakness.
The pins do not have to be lifted together.
A lock will accept them one at a time.
sentences.translationRu: Замок примет их и по одному.

sentences.text: Turn the cylinder very slightly
and one pin will catch on the edge.
sentences.translationRu: и один штифт зацепится за край.

sentences.text: Lift that one, and it stays up.
sentences.translationRu: Подними его — и он останется наверху.

sentences.text: Then find the next one.
That is what lock picking is.
Not force. Just doing it in slow motion.
sentences.translationRu: Не сила. Просто то же самое в замедленной съёмке.

sentences.text: Better locks add pins with strange shapes.
sentences.translationRu: Хорошие замки добавляют штифты странных форм.

sentences.text: They catch and feel like they worked.
They are there to waste your time.
sentences.translationRu: Они существуют, чтобы тратить твоё время.

sentences.text: Which is what a lock really sells.
sentences.translationRu: А время — это и есть то, что продаёт замок.

sentences.text: Not safety. Delay.

title: The world is running out of sand

sentences.text: Sand sounds like the last thing
anybody could possibly run short of.
There are entire deserts made of it.
And yet sand is the most extracted
sentences.translationRu: И тем не менее песок — самое добываемое

sentences.text: solid material on the planet.
More than oil, by weight, several times over.
sentences.translationRu: Больше нефти по массе, причём в разы.

sentences.text: Around fifty billion tonnes a year.
sentences.translationRu: Порядка пятидесяти миллиардов тонн в год.

sentences.text: The reason is concrete.
Concrete is mostly sand and stone
sentences.translationRu: Бетон — это в основном песок и щебень,

sentences.text: held together by a small amount of cement.
A single average house takes about two hundred tonnes.
sentences.translationRu: Один средний дом забирает около двухсот тонн.

sentences.text: A kilometre of motorway takes thirty thousand.
Glass is sand. Silicon chips are sand.
sentences.translationRu: Стекло — это песок. Кремниевые чипы — песок.

sentences.text: Land reclaimed from the sea is sand.
sentences.translationRu: Земля, отвоёванная у моря, — это песок.

sentences.text: And here is the catch.
Desert sand is almost useless for any of it.
sentences.translationRu: Пустынный песок почти ни для чего из этого не годится.

sentences.text: Wind-blown grains are rounded and smooth.
sentences.translationRu: Перенесённые ветром зёрна круглые и гладкие.

sentences.text: They roll past each other.
Concrete needs angular grains that lock.
sentences.translationRu: Бетону нужны угловатые зёрна, которые заклиниваются.

sentences.text: Those come from water, not wind.
sentences.translationRu: А такие даёт вода, не ветер.

sentences.text: So the sand that is wanted
is in rivers, lakes, beaches and seabeds.
sentences.translationRu: лежит в реках, озёрах, на пляжах и на дне.

sentences.text: Which are exactly the places
where removing it causes problems.
Take sand from a riverbed
and the river cuts deeper and faster.
sentences.translationRu: и река режет глубже и быстрее.

sentences.text: Bridges lose the ground under their feet.
Wells run dry as the water table drops.
Salt water moves up the channel from the sea.
sentences.translationRu: Солёная вода поднимается по руслу с моря.

sentences.text: Take it from a beach and the coast retreats.
sentences.translationRu: Забери с пляжа — и берег отступает.

sentences.text: Some islands have simply disappeared.
Because the sand they were made of was sold.
sentences.translationRu: Потому что песок, из которого они состояли, продали.

sentences.text: Where demand is high and rules are weak
sentences.translationRu: Там, где спрос высок, а правила слабы,

sentences.text: the trade turns criminal.
There are documented killings over river sand.
Which is a strange sentence to write
about an ordinary building material.
The fixes are known and slow.
Crushed rock instead of river sand.
Recycled concrete from demolished buildings.
Designing buildings to use less of it.
sentences.translationRu: Проектирование зданий, которым его нужно меньше.

sentences.text: None of that is difficult.
It is only more expensive than digging
something that appears to be free.

title: Wine smells of things that are not in it

sentences.text: Read any tasting note and it sounds absurd.
sentences.translationRu: Прочитай любую дегустационную заметку — звучит абсурдно.

sentences.text: Blackcurrant, pencil shavings, wet stone.
sentences.translationRu: Чёрная смородина, карандашная стружка, мокрый камень.

sentences.text: None of these are in the bottle.
The bottle contains grapes, yeast and time.
sentences.translationRu: В бутылке виноград, дрожжи и время.

sentences.text: The obvious reading is that it is nonsense.
A club language, invented to exclude people.
sentences.translationRu: Клубный язык, придуманный, чтобы не пускать чужих.

sentences.text: Part of it is exactly that.
Most of it is not.
Smell does not work like the other senses.
sentences.translationRu: Обоняние работает не как другие чувства.

sentences.text: Colour comes from three kinds of receptor.
sentences.translationRu: Цвет идёт от трёх типов рецепторов.

sentences.text: Smell uses around four hundred.
A single compound triggers several of them.
And a smell is the pattern across all of them.
sentences.translationRu: А запах — это узор по всем сразу.

sentences.text: Which means two completely different substances
can produce very similar patterns.
And therefore smell the same.
That is not an illusion or a mistake.
sentences.translationRu: Это не иллюзия и не ошибка.

sentences.text: It is what smelling is.
So a compound formed during fermentation
sentences.translationRu: Так что вещество, образовавшееся при брожении,

sentences.text: really can be the same one
sentences.translationRu: действительно может быть тем же самым,

sentences.text: that a blackcurrant leaf produces.
In several famous cases it literally is.
sentences.translationRu: В нескольких известных случаях оно буквально то же.

sentences.text: The wine is not reminding you of the fruit.
sentences.translationRu: Вино не напоминает тебе о ягоде.

sentences.text: It is emitting the same molecule.
The language problem is separate and real.
Human beings are poor at naming smells.
Astonishingly poor, when it is tested.
Present a familiar smell with no context
and most people cannot name it at all.
sentences.translationRu: и большинство вообще не сможет его назвать.

sentences.text: They know it. They just cannot reach the word.
sentences.translationRu: Они его знают. Просто не могут достать слово.

sentences.text: Most languages have almost no smell vocabulary.
sentences.translationRu: В большинстве языков словаря запахов почти нет.

sentences.text: Only words borrowed from the thing that smells.
sentences.translationRu: Только слова, одолженные у того, что пахнет.

sentences.text: Smells like coffee. Smells like rain.
So a taster has two choices.
Say nothing, or borrow a noun.
The borrowed nouns then look ridiculous
to anyone reading them on a label.
sentences.translationRu: для всякого, кто читает их на этикетке.

sentences.text: There is one honest caveat.
Expectation moves the answer enormously.
Colour a white wine red without telling anyone
sentences.translationRu: Подкрась белое вино в красный, не сказав никому,

sentences.text: and trained tasters describe red-wine aromas.
sentences.translationRu: и обученные дегустаторы опишут ароматы красного.

sentences.text: That study is real and was repeated.
So the compounds are there.
And the nose is also being told what to find.
sentences.translationRu: И носу при этом ещё и подсказывают, что искать.

sentences.text: Both things are true at once.
sentences.translationRu: И то и другое верно одновременно.

title: Why every city has a side nobody wants

sentences.text: Almost every old industrial city
sentences.translationRu: Почти в каждом старом промышленном городе

sentences.text: has a poorer half and a richer half.
Ask anybody local and they will name them.
sentences.translationRu: Спроси любого местного — он их назовёт.

sentences.text: Usually without having to think.
In a surprising number of cities
the poorer half is the east.
This has been measured, not just noticed.
sentences.translationRu: Это измеряли, а не просто замечали.

sentences.text: And the explanation is the wind.
In the middle latitudes the prevailing wind
blows from the west.
During industrialisation, cities burned coal.
sentences.translationRu: Во время индустриализации города жгли уголь.

sentences.text: Enormous quantities of it, badly.
Smoke, soot and sulphur went downwind.
sentences.translationRu: Дым, сажа и сера уходили по ветру.

sentences.text: Which meant east.
Anyone who could afford to choose
sentences.translationRu: Все, кто мог себе позволить выбирать,

sentences.text: chose to live upwind of the smoke.
So the west filled with money
and the east filled with everyone else.
The interesting part is what happened next.
The smoke stopped.
Coal was replaced. Air quality laws arrived.
sentences.translationRu: Уголь заменили. Пришли законы о качестве воздуха.

sentences.text: The original cause disappeared completely.
The pattern did not.
Because by then it was no longer about air.
sentences.translationRu: Потому что к тому времени дело было уже не в воздухе.

sentences.text: It was about everything built on top of the air.
sentences.translationRu: Дело было во всём, что на воздухе выстроилось.

sentences.text: Schools follow families with money.
sentences.translationRu: Школы следуют за семьями с деньгами.

sentences.text: Shops follow schools. Transport follows shops.
sentences.translationRu: Магазины — за школами. Транспорт — за магазинами.

sentences.text: Property prices follow all three.
sentences.translationRu: Цены на жильё — за всеми тремя.

sentences.text: And the price then decides who can arrive.
sentences.translationRu: А цена уже решает, кто сможет приехать.

sentences.text: Each step is individually reasonable.
None of them mentions the wind.
Economists call this path dependence.
sentences.translationRu: Экономисты зовут это зависимостью от пути.

sentences.text: A small early difference, locked in
by everything that arranges itself around it.
The cause can be removed entirely
and the outcome will continue by itself.
There is a lesson in it that is easy to miss.
sentences.translationRu: Здесь есть урок, который легко пропустить.

sentences.text: People explain such divisions with culture.
Or with character, or with choice.
Sometimes the real cause is two centuries dead
sentences.translationRu: Иногда настоящая причина мертва два века

sentences.text: and was never about people at all.
sentences.translationRu: и вообще никогда не была про людей.

sentences.text: It was about which way the air was moving
sentences.translationRu: Она была про то, куда дул воздух

sentences.text: over a town that no longer exists.

title: Pain is not a reading from the body

sentences.text: The intuitive model of pain is a wire.
Damage occurs. A signal travels up.
The brain receives it and reports the amount.
sentences.translationRu: Мозг его получает и сообщает величину.

sentences.text: More damage, more signal, more pain.
sentences.translationRu: Больше повреждения — больше сигнала — больше боли.

sentences.text: It is a reasonable model and it is wrong.
The evidence against it is not subtle.
Soldiers with severe wounds
have reported almost no pain at the time.
sentences.translationRu: сообщали о почти полном отсутствии боли в тот момент.

sentences.text: Athletes finish matches on broken bones.
sentences.translationRu: Спортсмены доигрывают матчи на сломанных костях.

sentences.text: Meanwhile people live with constant severe pain
sentences.translationRu: А другие живут с постоянной сильной болью

sentences.text: in limbs that were amputated years ago.
There is no wire left to carry anything.
sentences.translationRu: Провода, который что-то несёт, уже нет.

sentences.text: And the pain is not imaginary.
sentences.translationRu: И боль при этом не воображаемая.

sentences.text: It is measurable, and it is disabling.
The better model treats pain as an output.
Not an input.
Something the brain produces, rather than receives.
sentences.translationRu: Тем, что мозг производит, а не получает.

sentences.text: Damage signals are one input among several.
sentences.translationRu: Сигналы повреждения — лишь один вход из нескольких.

sentences.text: The others include what you can see.
sentences.translationRu: Другие включают то, что ты видишь.

sentences.text: What you expect. What it means.
Whether you are safe. Whether help is near.
sentences.translationRu: В безопасности ли ты. Близка ли помощь.

sentences.text: The brain weighs all of it
and answers a single question.
How urgently should this body protect itself?
sentences.translationRu: Насколько срочно телу надо себя защитить?

sentences.text: Pain is that answer, made unignorable.
sentences.translationRu: Боль — это тот ответ, сделанный неигнорируемым.

sentences.text: Which explains the strange cases immediately.
A soldier who is about to be rescued
does not need to be stopped from moving.
sentences.translationRu: не нуждается в том, чтобы его обездвижили.

sentences.text: So the answer is turned down.
A nervous system that has produced pain for years
becomes better at producing it.
Pathways strengthen with use, as they always do.
sentences.translationRu: Пути усиливаются от использования, как всегда.

sentences.text: Eventually the alarm needs less and less
sentences.translationRu: В конце концов сигналу нужно всё меньше,

sentences.text: to go off, and sometimes nothing.
sentences.translationRu: чтобы сработать, а иногда и ничего.

sentences.text: This has changed how chronic pain is treated.
Badly, and slowly, and not everywhere.
The old approach hunted for tissue damage.
And when scans found none, implied invention.
sentences.translationRu: А когда снимки ничего не находили, намекал на выдумку.

sentences.text: Which is both cruel and factually confused.
sentences.translationRu: Что и жестоко, и фактически спутанно.

sentences.text: Explaining the mechanism to patients
turns out to reduce pain on its own.
Not because it was imaginary.
sentences.translationRu: Не потому, что она была воображаемой.

sentences.text: But because threat is one of the inputs.
sentences.translationRu: А потому, что угроза — один из входов.

sentences.text: And understanding lowers threat.
